title: Balance Cushion on Long-Term Hardship Hold Extensions — Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
**Client review standard.** Under Hardship and Protective Holds, the balance allowance of a long-term extension of a Long-Term Hardship Hold depends on the held account's balance due, as shown in its Placed Consumer Accounts record. The larger cushion follows the larger balance because the client reviews a larger balance before collection on it may resume. The allowance is added once to the days the long-term extension adds.

## Bands

| Held account's balance due | Balance allowance |
|---|---|
| At least the large-balance amount of $5000.00 | 10 calendar days (large-balance days) |
| At least the mid-balance amount of $1000.00 but below $5000.00 | 5 calendar days (mid-balance days) |
| Below $1000.00 | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Balance due | Allowance |
|---|---|
| $5000.00 | 10 days |
| $4999.99 | 5 days |
| $1000.00 | 5 days |
| $999.99 | Nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** A held account with a balance due of $2750.00 is at least $1000.00 and below $5000.00: 5 calendar days are added.
